735100101.text: Hajanad, it was a great success. Wanna hear the good news?

735100102.text: Hold on a moment. Allow me to sense the Shock-Boiling Device you have on you.

735100103.text: Ah, this blazing warmth, this magnetic echo! It is like a chorus of alchemical potions in the flames. Such... such excitement!

735100104.text: Impeccable, I say! Using the data you've provided, I'm sure I'll be able to write the most perfect report!

735100106.text: "White High-Intelligence Floating Assistive Unit," you should read a few... books of late-night Akademiya quotations. It will help enhance your linguistic variety!

735100107.text: That way, you will be able to understand many intricate analogies, and both your humor and resistance to stress will increase manifold.

735100108.text: #Nah, Paimon doesn't get what you're saying, and there's no stress anyway. Besides, {NICKNAME}'s not the type to make Paimon do any strange experiments!

735100109.text: Anyway, don't change the subject. We've performed the experiment as we agreed...

735100111.text: You'll have it, you'll have it! Come on, don't you trust me?

735100112.text: Eh? This is fifty people's salary? This... kinda feels different from what Paimon expected.

735100113.text: Err, not that it's too little or anything...

735100116.text: Eh? Did the Mora I saved over this half a year not pack enough of a punch for you?

735100117.text: Did I underestimate the price that mercenaries can fetch? The daily wage I planned for them was the same as the daily allowance my mentor gave me, though!

735100118.text: My new mentor's very generous, too! Now that I'm under her, I can have one Shawarma Wrap every day and still have funds left over!

735100119.text: If I bought a bag of flour and picked some Zaytun Peaches outdoors, then grabbed several buckets of river water to cook them into paste, I could even live for two weeks on a single day's funds!

735100120.text: Then, the leftover funds can be diverted back into Shock-Boiled Brew research. And that's how I came up with my estimate for mercenary pay!

735109901.text: Hehe! We've been testing the Shock-Boiling Device this whole time. Paimon thinks we've gathered enough data.

735109902.text: Let's go look for Hajanad and tell her about our user experience!
